description: This Java class `PayrollSystemAdapter` implements the `PayrollSystemPort` interface. It acts as an adapter for sending employee payroll information to an external payroll system via JMS messaging. The class uses Spring Framework annotations for dependency injection, configures message properties, and logs the message sending process.

classes.name: PayrollSystemAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that implements payroll system messaging by converting employee DTOs into JMS messages with specific properties and sending them via a configured JMS template.

methods.name: sendEmployeeInfo
methods.description: Sends employee information to the external payroll system by converting an EmployeeDTO into a JMS message, setting specific properties, and dispatching it via JMS template.
